subject: Nimbus POC — access, success criteria, and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.gupta@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nimbus POC — access, success criteria, and next steps

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Below is a brief recap and proposed next steps so we can get the sandbox POC underway next week. Please reply with any edits and confirm owners for the bullets in bold.

POC objective
- Validate Redwood’s hosted inference for Nimbus Health use cases: patient-facing summarization and secure retrieval augmentation.

Success criteria (tentative) — please confirm:
1) Latency: 95th percentile <= 300ms for single-turn summarization at 512 tokens.
2) Cost: token cost < $0.002 per 1k tokens on average for the evaluation workload.
3) Accuracy: human eval of 200 prompts — >= 90% acceptable relevance/accuracy.
4) Security: logs and data retention controls in place; SSO access for reviewers and IP allowlist for sandbox.

Evaluation plan / timeline
- Sandbox provisioning and SSO invites: target by 2026-07-10 (owner: Redwood infra).
- Baseline run and smoke tests: 2026-07-11 to 2026-07-12 (owner: Nimbus eng).
- Evaluation run + human review: 2026-07-13 to 2026-07-16 (owner: Nimbus PM).
- Follow-up review and decision: week of 2026-07-20.

Access we need from you (please provide by 2026-07-09):
- Primary technical point of contact for firewall/IP allowlisting (name + public IP ranges).
- SSO domain for Okta/GSuite so we can send invites to your reviewers.
- Any sandbox dataset or sample prompts you want preloaded.

What Redwood will provide
- Sandbox API key scoped to test environment (rotatable) and a short-lived test secret for engineers.
- SSO invites for reviewer accounts + role-based access.
- An evaluation notebook with sample queries and metrics collection.

Attachments: nimbus-poc-success-criteria.pdf (draft), ip-allowlist-template.csv

Next steps
- Alex/Priya: confirm IP lead + SSO domain by end of day 7/9.
- Nikhil/Dev: I’ll loop you in to provision keys and SSO invites once Alex confirms.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: nimbus-poc-success-criteria.pdf (PDF, 45KB); ip-allowlist-template.csv (CSV, 1KB)

Thanks Marissa — that looks good and aligns with our internal goals. Quick answers:

- Owners: Priya (PM) will own the evaluation and human review; I (Alex) will be the technical lead for the POC.
- IP lead: James Reddy (james.reddy@nimbushealth.com) — he owns infra and will share IP ranges.
- SSO: Our Okta domain is nimbushealth.okta.com — you can send invites to reviewer accounts (we'll provide list).

Couple of asks from our side:
1) Can the sandbox API key be restricted to a single environment and have token rotation documented?
2) We'll need sample evaluation queries and a template for the human review rubric (if you can include that in the Drive link).

We'll aim to get the IP ranges and reviewer email list to you by end of day Friday (2026-07-09).

Thanks — cc'ing Priya so she has visibility.

Hi Alex — thanks for the info. For the allowlist, we typically need the public CIDR blocks and a contact for any scheduled maintenance window. A few notes: 

- We can allowlist the following example ranges (please confirm actuals): 52.24.128.0/20, 18.196.0.0/16. If James can confirm his public egress CIDRs we’ll use those exact values.
- If your firewall requires a change window, provide the preferred times and we’ll coordinate with ops.
- Regarding the API key: we'll provision a scoped key for the sandbox and document rotation — keys are short-lived (30 days) by default for POCs; we can extend if needed but recommend rotation after go/no-go.

Requested attachments: I’ve attached an ip-allowlist-template.csv you can fill out with CIDRs and owner contacts so we can expedite. Once you reply with the filled template we’ll open the final allowlist change request.

Thanks — I’ll watch for James’ CIDRs and the reviewer list to send invites.
